chunks.title: Vodafone International Holdings B.V. v. Union of India, (2012) 6 SCC 613
chunks.content:
### Vodafone International Holdings B.V. v. Union of India, (2012) 6 SCC 613
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (S.H. Kapadia, CJI)
**Core Holding:** Established the "look at" rather than "look through" approach to genuine corporate share transfer transactions involving foreign holding structures, emphasizing certainty in fiscal statutes.

chunks.title: Union of India v. Mohit Minerals Pvt. Ltd., (2022) 10 SCC 700
chunks.content:
### Union of India v. Mohit Minerals Pvt. Ltd., (2022) 10 SCC 700
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (D.Y. Chandrachud, J.)
**Core Holding:** Clarified the advisory nature of GST Council recommendations and held that separate levy of IGST on ocean freight in CIF contracts is impermissible where customs value already covers freight.

chunks.title: Appellate Hierarchy & Pre-Deposit Rules
chunks.content:
### Appellate Hierarchy & Pre-Deposit Rules
1. **Appellate Chain:** Assessment Order -> Commissioner (Appeals) -> ITAT/CESTAT -> High Court (Substantial Question of Law under §260A) -> Supreme Court.
2. **Pre-Deposit Requirements:** Mandatory 20% or statutory pre-deposit for grant of stay of demand during appeal pendency.

chunks.title: Income Tax Act, 1961
chunks.content:
### Income Tax Act, 1961
- **Section 147 & 148:** Reassessment of income escaping assessment; requires tangible material and live link before issuing reassessment notice.
- **Section 37:** General deduction for expenditure laid out wholly and exclusively for the purpose of business or profession.

chunks.title: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (CGST Act)
chunks.content:
### Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (CGST Act)
- **Section 16:** Eligibility and conditions for taking Input Tax Credit (ITC) on invoice issuance and tax payment.
- **Section 73 & 74:** Determination of tax unpaid or short paid for reasons other than fraud (Section 73) or by reason of fraud/willful misstatement (Section 74).
